articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 35% improvement over GPT-5 on complex software engineering tasks, with significantly reduced hallucination rates on factual retrieval. The model is available via API with a new structured-output guarantee mode aimed at enterprise integration.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved 89% of International Mathematical Olympiad problems from the last decade, surpassing all previous AI systems. The model uses a novel chain-of-thought verification loop that cross-checks intermediate proof steps against a formal theorem prover. Researchers say this hybrid neuro-symbolic approach could accelerate automated theorem proving and scientific discovery workflows.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Manufacturing Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in select Gigafactory production lines for parts handling and quality inspection tasks. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22 degrees of freedom per hand and can adapt to novel objects using on-device vision-language models. Tesla reports a 40% reduction in task error rates compared to Gen 2 prototypes demonstrated earlier this year.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform for Construction Site Autonomy
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, backed by Hyundai, revealed the commercial Atlas platform designed for autonomous operation on active construction sites, including rebar carrying, site surveying, and hazard detection. The system integrates real-time 3D SLAM with LLM-based task planning, enabling natural language work orders from site supervisors. Pilot programs are scheduled across South Korean and U.S. infrastructure projects starting Q1 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Oversight Framework for Autonomous Agent Systems
articles.summary: Anthropic published a new constitutional AI framework specifically designed to govern long-running autonomous agents that execute multi-step tasks with real-world side effects. The framework includes a formal specification language for safety constraints and a runtime monitor that can interrupt agent execution when behavioral drift is detected. The release is accompanied by an open-source reference implementation and a benchmark suite for evaluating agent alignment under adversarial conditions.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node, Enabling Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its N1.4 process node at its Kaohsiung fab, with first customer shipments expected by early 2027. The node delivers approximately 25% performance gains and 35% power efficiency improvements over N2, critical for next-generation AI training and inference chips. Major customers including Nvidia and Apple are reported to have secured early capacity allocations.

articles.title: Meta Demonstrates Real-Time Neural Holographic Display Prototype for AR Glasses
articles.summary: Meta's Reality Labs showcased a working prototype of AR glasses using neural holographic displays that render true 3D light fields in real time, eliminating the vergence-accommodation conflict that plagues current headsets. The system uses a custom AI rendering pipeline that compresses holographic computation by 100x, running on a belt-mounted mobile compute unit. Meta says a developer edition could ship by late 2027, positioning the technology as a successor to waveguide-based displays.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Phase Begins with First Compliance Audits of Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office has initiated the first formal compliance audits under the AI Act's general-purpose AI model provisions, targeting major foundation model providers operating in the EU. Companies must demonstrate adequate risk assessments, red-teaming documentation, and compute reporting for models trained above the 10^25 FLOP threshold. The enforcement actions mark a pivotal moment in global AI regulation and are expected to set precedents for similar frameworks under development in the U.S. and Japan.
